LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a party.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

ChargesAccount.name: Charges Account
ChargesAccount.definition: Account to be used for charges/fees if different from the account for payment.

CommissionAccount.name: Commission Account
CommissionAccount.definition: Account to be used for commission if different from the account for payment.

TaxAccount.name: Tax Account
TaxAccount.definition: Account to be used for taxes if different from the account for payment.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information to a party identification.
